# mv: rename a type in a group declaration
mv T NewT
-- x.go --
package m

type (
	T int
	U string
)

func F(x T) T { return x }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,8 +1,8 @@
 package m

 type (
-	T int
-	U string
+	NewT int
+	U    string
 )

-func F(x T) T { return x }
+func F(x NewT) NewT { return x }
